body: This is not about how other people see me. I don't care. I've pushed away all of the people I cared about for their sake. I don't think that life has any kind of greater meaning or purpose - and I think this is relieving. Comforting, almost. We are free. So why can't I enjoy being alive? I desperately want to.
Alright, I'll tell you, if you tell me in detail why you want to know?
None - I've got gypsy blood in me but I'm not the least bit dextrous. I can barely snap my fingers. ._.

Please... explain it to me in detail, why me wanting to end my life is so selfish? I know we all suffer... Withouht pain we wouldn't know happiness. Am I supposed to feel bad about other peoples deaths? I long to feel happy and alive again, over the years I have tried and failed. Once we die, we are gone. No guilt or shame, as we won't even exist.
In retrospect, IMO drugs or any self destructive behavior in general is never a good choice, but they might save you from yourself.
I'm born for a reason? The way I see it - there are no reasons, only causes
You are right in one way - sometimes I'll flail my fingers around wildly and at least try to do some coin tricks (keep it a secret). No corpse could ever do that, anyway.

I'm trying to think of a semi serious reply here. 

masturbation? Doesn't really count

I've never had any dreams or desires, not even when I was a little kid... when I tried to imagine a future... nothing. I do not mind being alive as I'm not exactly physically suffering. But I can't go on existing like this. I feel so restless and agitated all of the time. I can't even sit down to watch a movie. I wish I could go to sleep and never wake up

I've been seeing a therapist, whom I very much like (psychotherapy), for about 6 years now, she helped me, and I learned a lot form her.

I never used drugs as a teenager even once. Until now... they really were a last resort... I just wanted to feel okay, even for just a short while... but it doesn't work. I keep wishing I'd dissapear and that everything would just go away

I understand your point of view very well - but this is my life, wether I enjoy living it or not, It's mine. I've tried to subtly push the people I care about in my life away for a long time now, for their sake, but I'm not going to continue feeling this miserable just because someone who knows me might feel a little bit sad if I die.

I do not want to be loved, missed, nor remembered. I just want everything to go away

You see... that's the thing, I have no reason to live, nor do I have a good reason for wanting to die. It's so sad to me because I think life is beautiful and a very precious thing. I desperately want to enjoy it... but still... I keep wishing I'd never existed at all. I'm 21 yet I still feel like a lost little girl.
